title: Be in the Heart of Downtown
description:
Downtown Nashville is your backyard, put your bags down and get ready to hit the town!   
The condo is on the ground level of an exclusive residential building right in the midst of all that downtown has to offer. Most of the best restaurants, bars and events within 4 blocks of the condo
THE SHORTEST WALK TO THE  NISSAN STADIUM!

The space
No parking is provided. This is downtown, you should be able to walk everywhere! 
If you need to park:
The best parking option is right next to the condo at the city plaza. It is under the park covered. You can leave your vehicle overnight and it has the least expensive rates as well. That’s where all the locals park. 
Check out the website parkitdowntown. com

Guest access
The entire condo is yours! 
We have the August lock for the door and 2 keys inside the condo as well.  Please be sure keys are kept in the condo upon check-out.
